maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset-management fees on investment funds and portfolios in real assets, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are financial advisors, wealth platforms, institutions and retail investors paying management fees; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from launching strategies and funds organically (REITs, infrastructure, preferreds); no acquisition roll-up pattern.

mission_critical.reason: Investors can redeem mutual funds or move mandates to other managers fairly easily; no regulatory or operational lock-in.
